_readme: Official project work packages from Annex I (Description of the Action) and Application Form Part B.

workPackages.title: Management and Coordination
workPackages.lead: National School of Business Management Ltd (NSBM Green University)
objectives: Ensure timely, transparent, and compliant project implementation across all partner institutions
Monitor progress against project objectives, KPIs, and risk mitigation strategies
Provide independent external evaluation and strategic guidance through the External Advisory Committee (EAC)
Ensure financial accountability, transparent budgeting, and compliance with Erasmus+ rules
activities: Establishment of Project Steering Committee (PSC) and consortium governance structures
Organization of kick-off meeting in Sri Lanka (Month 2) and regular virtual coordination sessions
Financial and administrative management, budget monitoring, and interim/final reporting
Establishment and operation of the independent External Advisory Committee (EAC)
Risk management, ethics compliance, data protection, and corrective action oversight
outcomes: Approved governance structure, Quality Assurance Plan, KPI framework, and risk register
Timely submission of all technical and financial reports to EACEA
Smooth consortium cooperation and external strategic guidance

workPackages.title: Curriculum and Learning Framework Development
objectives: Address industry skills gaps and graduate work-readiness in partner countries
Integrate AI ethics, sustainability, and green computing into ICT curricula
Redesign internships as competence-based learning pathways aligned with European standards
activities: Design of a shared competence framework integrating AI, green computing, and ethics (aligned with EQF, DigComp, and GreenComp)
Development of modular curriculum updates and 4–5 micro-credentials (5–10 ECTS)
Redesign of structured, AI-resilient internship models, assessment rubrics, and learning agreements
Transnational validation workshop in Germany (Month 13) and staff mobility to Novi Sad School of Business
outcomes: Comprehensive European-aligned ICT Competence Framework Report
Modular curriculum packages and 10 ECTS MOOC-based certificate
Redesigned dual-education internship guidelines endorsed by industry

workPackages.title: Capacity Building
objectives: Train academic staff in ethical, sustainable, and inclusive ICT teaching and competence-based assessment
Prepare industry mentors for high-quality, fair, and structured internship supervision
Adapt institutional QA and credit recognition systems in Partner Country HEIs for sustainable delivery
activities: Train-the-trainers and cascade training programmes for academic staff across partner HEIs
Industry mentor training and short-term mobility to Novi Sad School of Business (Serbia)
Institutional readiness support: adapting QA procedures, credit recognition, and prior learning policies
Mid-term transnational review meeting in Serbia (Month 25)
outcomes: At least 120 staff trained (≥80 academic staff + ≥40 industry mentors)
Certified workplace mentors and academic trainers
Approved institutional credit recognition and QA guidelines across partner HEIs

workPackages.title: Implementation and Testing
workPackages.lead: NSBM Green University (with SLIIT, UOC, and UOP)
objectives: Deliver and test revised ICT curricula and micro-credentials with students across Partner Country HEIs
Implement structured, AI-resilient internships with at least 300 students annually
Collect evidence of improved graduate readiness, employer satisfaction, and learning outcomes
activities: Pilot delivery of revised ICT modules and micro-credentials with student cohorts
Roll-out of structured internships with industry partners using digital portfolios
Competence-based student assessment, feedback collection, and student ambassador cohorts
Mid-pilot review and transnational adjustment meetings in Bhutan (Month 32)
outcomes: At least 300 students completing structured internships per year
Documented internship case studies, best practices guide, and evaluation datasets

workPackages.title: Quality Assurance, Monitoring and Evaluation
objectives: Establish and operate a comprehensive quality assurance and monitoring system throughout the project
Track progress against objectives, KPIs, CBHE indicators, and pilot results in real time
Conduct mid-term and final internal evaluations supporting external EAC reviews
activities: Setup and maintenance of the Quality Assurance Plan, monitoring tools, and KPI dashboards
Continuous progress and risk monitoring with quarterly briefs for the Steering Committee
Mid-term internal evaluation (Month 18) and final internal evaluation (Month 35)
outcomes: Continuous quality control, early risk mitigation, and KPI tracking
Comprehensive mid-term and final evaluation reports validating CBHE indicators

workPackages.title: Dissemination, Exploitation and Sustainability
workPackages.lead: National School of Business Management Ltd (NSBM Green University)
objectives: Develop and maintain project communication channels (website, media, newsletters) to promote results
Engage stakeholders (ministries, HEIs, industry, students) to ensure uptake of project outputs
Produce a final Sustainability & Exploitation Plan, OER repository, and policy recommendations
activities: Development and maintenance of the multilingual project website, social media, and newsletters
Organization of national and regional dissemination workshops and industry forums
Publication of Open Educational Resources (OER) package under open licenses
Finalization, Sustainability & Closing Conference in Maldives (Month 34)
outcomes: High regional and international visibility for the GECRIS initiative
Open-access learning resources and toolkits for long-term regional replication
Signed MOUs and policy briefs securing institutional continuation after project end
